note: A rustic campground in Beaver-Cowan Lake Recreation Site, 16 km N of Green Lake where Hwy 155 crosses the Beaver River at the Cowan River mouth. The sites are spread over a flat open lawn with aspen bluffs on the steep north bank of the Beaver River, for nearly a kilometre; there is no water source listed. --Claude
